subject: Coordinating Samir Patel's virtual onsite — evaluator pairing & booking
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: RecruiterOps <recruiterops@hiringpartners.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual onsite availability + two proposed formats (short/extended)

Hi all —

Samir is excited to move forward with a virtual onsite. To make scheduling faster I put together two compact options (all times PT) — please reply with preferences or conflicts. Samir, feel free to confirm which option works best and any hard constraints.

Option A — single-day compact (tight):
  • 09:30–10:15 Tech system design (EM + Eng)
  • 10:30–11:15 Deep dive + code review (2 interviewers)
  • 11:30–12:00 Lunch / quick break
  • 12:00–12:45 Cross-functional interview (PM + Data)
  • 13:00–13:30 Debrief (panel sync) — internal only

Option B — split-day (recommended for timezone breathing room):
  Day 1 (Morning):
    • 09:00–09:45 System design (EM)
    • 10:00–10:45 Code exercise discussion (2 interviewers)
  Day 2 (Afternoon):
    • 12:00–12:45 Behavioral + role fit (Hiring Manager + Recruiting)
    • 13:00–13:30 Debrief (internal)

For panel pairing, suggested interviewers below — please flag swaps ASAP:
  • System design: Maya Srinivasan (HM)
  • Code exercise: Laura Bennett + Neha Kapoor (eng leads)
  • Cross-functional: Avery Johnson (prod-collab)

Attachments: candidate resume (samir_patel_resume.pdf), initial eval rubric (attached).

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gmail.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite availability + two proposed formats (short/extended)

Hi Michael,

Thanks — Option B (split-day) works much better given my current commitments. I prefer morning blocks on Day 1. I’m in PST. One note: I need to avoid any calls that start before 09:00 PT.

Also quick Q — is there a short take-home or a live pairing exercise? I want to make sure I carve the right prep time.

Best,
Samir

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite availability + two proposed formats (short/extended)

Thanks Michael — copy. Samir, welcome and glad you can do split-day. Confirming the panel pairings but a couple of asks:

  1) Laura, Neha — can you take the code exercise block on Day 1 at 10:00 PT? Laura, if you need a swap, please propose someone from the eng IC rotation.
  2) Michael — please send the candidate prep brief and a link to the short pairing exercise if there is one. We'll assume a 45-minute live discussion rather than a take-home unless we hear otherwise.
  3) Internal debrief will be 30 minutes and must be internal-only. If someone can't make that sync, we should capture notes on the eval rubric.

I’ll also book a backup interviewer (Neha as primary backup) and request 15-minute buffer before each block.

Avery Johnson
Product Partnerships (interview lead)

Hi Michael / Avery —

Appreciate the clear schedule and the buffer. Confirmed for both days — looking forward to the conversations. I did get the prep brief and resume link. I don’t need a take-home; the live discussion format is fine.

One small ask: will there be a short (10–15 min) time at the end of the behavioral session to answer a few logistical questions about onboarding and benefits? If so, great — otherwise happy to follow up separately.

Thanks again — excited to meet the team.

Best,
Samir
